request.title: It's okay, son. I love you
request.prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. Scene: a small elven village at dusk on the day it was raided. A seven-year-old child version of Durzo (same silver-white hair and face as the reference, but a small boy) clings sobbing to his father Gren, a broad-shouldered elven blacksmith in a leather apron, in front of their cottage doorway, where his mother Silver, an elven healer, looks on in alarm. Around the corner a horde of orcs with torches is coming. At the edge of the village stands a tall ornate mirror, shimmering. Heartbreaking and tender, epic in scale. Characters: Durzo: a lean half-elf rogue with swept-back silver-white hair and pointed ears, in fitted red-and-black leather armour.

references.role: Character appearance reference for Durzo. Preserve the face, hair, build, colours and outfit shown; ignore the background, base and any interface elements.

request.alt: A young Durzo clings in tears to his father outside their cottage as orcs with torches round the corner, a shimmering mirror waiting at the village edge.
